shortDescription: Manipulate general SNMP settings on a BIG-IP

options.name: agent_authentication_traps
options.description: When C(enabled), ensures the system sends authentication warning traps to the trap destinations. This is usually disabled by default on a BIG-IP.

options.name: agent_status_traps
options.description: When C(enabled), ensures the system sends a trap whenever the SNMP agent starts running or stops running. This is usually enabled by default on a BIG-IP.

options.name: allowed_addresses
options.description: Configures the IP addresses of the SNMP clients from which the snmpd daemon accepts requests. This value can be hostnames, IP addresses, or IP networks. You may specify a single list item of C(default) to set the value back to the system default of C(127.0.0.0/8). You can remove all allowed addresses by either providing the word C(none), or by providing the empty string C("").

options.name: contact
options.description: Specifies the name of the person who administers the SNMP service for this system.

options.name: device_warning_traps
options.description: When C(enabled), ensures the system sends device warning traps to the trap destinations. This is usually enabled by default on a BIG-IP.

options.name: location
options.description: Specifies the description of this system's physical location.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
